# Evolve Artist

> > A comprehensive online art education platform teaching painting fundamentals and professional art skills from beginner to advanced levels.

Evolve Artist is an online art education platform founded by Kevin Murphy and featuring instruction from industry professionals including Chris Oatley, Todd Lockwood, and other artists with experience at studios like Disney, Lucasfilm, and Google. The platform offers structured curriculum in painting fundamentals, direct painting, and speed painting techniques.

## Key Topics

- Art Education
- Online Courses
- Painting Fundamentals
- Professional Development
- Direct Painting
- Speed Painting
- Foundation Blocks
- Beginner to Professional
- Art Skills Training
- Community Support
- Curriculum Structure
- Enrollment
- Course Pricing
